cli.intro: open-mv — song-first MV authoring: analyze the song, write the shot script, render
cli.cmd.analyze: Analyze a PCM WAV song: BPM, beat offset and sections (positional: <song.wav>)
cli.cmd.plan: Plan the storyboard from a song without rendering (positional: <song.wav>)
cli.cmd.presets: List the MV preset catalogue (palettes, camera moves, lyric text styles)
cli.cmd.render: Render a film module that default-exports an OpenCut Film (positional: <film.ts>)
cli.cmd.verify: Render to a temporary MP4 and check duration, level, clipping and scenes (positional: <film.ts>)
cli.opt.lines: Lyric lines file, one line per lyric
